data.title: Social Security board election ‘not postponed’
data.description: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has insisted that the election for the Social Security Office (SSO) board has not been postponed, but only temporarily halted after the Supreme Administrative Court issued an injunction, which the SSO plans to appeal.

data.title: PM says Senate case no threat to coalition
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed concerns that allegations of collusion in the Senate election could undermine the coalition government’s stability.

data.title: Former bank manager held after two slain in land dispute
data.description: A former bank manager has been arrested after shooting five relatives, killing two and injuring three, in a long-running dispute over an access road in Bang Bua Thong district of Nonthaburi on Tuesday.

data.title: Two Chinese burglary suspects arrested at Suvarnabhumi
data.description: Two Chinese nationals wanted in connection with a series of luxury home burglaries in Nonthaburi province have been arrested at Suvarnabhumi airport after returning to Thailand.

data.title: Police to quiz two senior officials over exam fraud
data.description: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) will summon two senior officials for questioning over their alleged roles in the local government recruitment exam fraud after investigators found evidence linking them to the scheme.

data.title: Major shake-up at Agriculture and Cooperatives Ministry
data.description: The cabinet on Monday approved a major reshuffle of nine senior Agriculture and Cooperatives Ministry officials.

data.title: People's Party blasts civil service reform plan
data.description: People's Party deputy leader Sirikanya Tansakun has urged the government to rethink its proposed early retirement scheme for civil servants, arguing that it has put the cart before the horse by prioritising workforce reductions before deciding which state agencies should be merged or abolished.

data.title: Major shake-up at ministry
data.description: The cabinet yesterday approved a major reshuffle of nine senior Agriculture and Cooperatives Ministry officials.

data.title: Cabinet backs VAT cut extension to 2027
data.description: The cabinet has approved in principle a one-year extension of the country's 7% value-added tax (VAT) rate until Sept 30, 2027, in a move aimed at easing living costs, stimulating consumer spending and supporting economic stability.

data.title: CIB to quiz two officials over exam fraud
data.description: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) will summon two senior officials for questioning over their alleged roles in the local government recruitment exam fraud after investigators found evidence linking them to the scheme.

data.title: Deadly attack roils South peace talks
data.description: A deadly checkpoint attack in Narathiwat that killed five rangers complicates southern peace talks, though overall security will not significantly deteriorate, veteran politician Wan Muhamad Noor Matha said yesterday.

data.title: Phiphat dismisses rumours of a rift within Bhumjaithai
data.description: Deputy Prime Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn yesterday dismissed rumours of a rift involving Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, influential Bhumjaithai Party figure Newin Chidchob and himself.

data.title: City alert sounds over high tides
data.description: Bangkok and six central provinces have been warned to prepare for unusually high tides from July 28 to Aug 1, with authorities cautioning that rivers may overflow and inundate low-lying communities along the Chao Phraya River and its canal network.

data.title: PM defends shift from Land Bridge to Missing Link
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul yesterday defended the government's decision to scale back the Land Bridge megaproject, saying it had been adapted -- not abandoned -- in response to financial, environmental and geopolitical realities.

data.title: 7 Chiang Mai temples next in line for Unesco listing
data.description: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin said Thailand will seek Unesco World Heritage status for seven temples in Chiang Mai.

data.title: PP blasts civil service reform plan
data.description: People's Party deputy leader Sirikanya Tansakun has urged the government to rethink its proposed early retirement scheme for civil servants, arguing that it has put the cart before the horse by prioritising workforce reductions before deciding which state agencies should be merged or abolished.

data.title: Keys building beyond data infrastructure
data.description: As Thailand accelerates investment in digital infrastructure in pursuit of a value-based, high-income economy, attention is increasingly turning to the environmental and social footprint of data centres.

data.title: PM rejects Senate vote claim
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul dismissed concerns that allegations of collusion in the Senate election could undermine the coalition government's stability.

data.title: Firms back growth push
data.description: Thailand's leading corporations have joined forces with government agencies to establish 928 district-based social enterprise companies nationwide, aiming to strengthen local economies and create lasting social impact during the country's two auspicious royal years in 2026 and 2027.

data.title: Three Indian abductees rescued after being lured to Pattaya and tortured
data.description: PATTAYA: Police rescued three Indian men after they had been held for ransom by a scam gang that lured them from their homeland to Pattaya with a cheap tour package and tortured them for a week.

data.title: Building collapses during demolition for Orange Line project
data.description: A five-storey building collapsed during demolition work to make way for the Orange Line electric train system in Din Daeng district, Bangkok, on Monday evening.

data.title: Former Thai tennis player found dead with signs of assault
data.description: Police are investigating the death of Natthawee Sukantharun, better known as “Coach Nat,” a former Thai national tennis and beach-tennis player who was found dead at his home in Bang Lamung district, Chon Buri province, on Sunday.

data.title: Cabinet eases criteria for welfare card recipients
data.description: The cabinet has approved revised eligibility criteria for the State Welfare Card, allowing about 9.3 million rejected applicants to appeal and possibly be approved.

data.title: Retired tennis star found dead with wounds
data.description: Police are investigating the death of Natthawee Sukantharun, better known as “Coach Nat”, a former Thai national tennis and beach tennis player who was found dead at his home in Bang Lamung district, Chon Buri, on Sunday.

data.title: Two senior officials face charges in civil service exam rigging scandal
data.description: Two high-level officials have been summoned to hear police charges in relation to the rigging of results of the civil service recruitment examination for local government bodies nationwide.

data.title: GMMTV backlash mounts over fan-security guards clash
data.description: A confrontation between a Chinese fan and security personnel at the International Novel Festival 2026 has sparked widespread criticism of the organiser, Thai entertainment giant GMMTV, which felt compelled to issue an explanatory statement on Monday.
